test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.**

options.text: It turns out multiple groups have measured the concensus.
The proposed cuts have caused considerable contraversy.
The companies may lose a lot of their overseas exposure.
She was in a bouyant mood and was looking forward to her new life.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The companies may lose a lot of their overseas exposure.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Among the given options, the sentence with no spelling error is in option 3.**
 
• **All words in this sentence are spelled correctly.**
 
• **"Concensus" **in Option 1 should be spelled as "consensus."
 
 
• It means an agreement among a group of people. (लोगों के बीच) आम सहमति; सर्वसम्मति
 
 
 
• **"Contraversy"** in Option 2 should be spelled as "controversy."
 
 
• It means public discussion and disagreement about something. (किसी विषय पर) सार्वजनिक चर्चा और विवाद
 
 
 
• **"Bouyant" **in Option 4 should be spelled as "buoyant."
 
 
• It means happy and confident. (प्रसन्‍न तथा विश्‍वासपूर्ण)
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
